mean: to go about it, to handle it

mean: to matter a lot to someone
ex: Ce voyage me tient vraiment à cœur.
exEn: This trip really matters to me.

ex: Il a laissé tomber le piano après deux mois.
exEn: He gave up the piano after two months.

mean: in a row, back to back

mean: to step through the door, to cross the threshold

exEn: As soon as you step inside, it smells of coffee.

exEn: To make crêpes, you need to have the knack.

exEn: That rejection was hard to take.

exEn: Shall we review the project on Friday?
